research_question: Among cleft/VPI patients undergoing velopharyngeal surgery, what is the postoperative proportion of OSA when restricted to PSG-confirmed evidence?
hypothesis: OSA ascertainment varies by technique and by outcome definition; single-arm synthesis is appropriate.
objectives: Estimate PSG-confirmed postoperative OSA proportions by surgical technique.
Separate claims and screening-only evidence as sensitivity/narrative evidence.
Prepare a conservative SIICUSP abstract package without causal or network-comparison claims.
inclusion_criteria: Cleft/VPI surgical cohorts with postoperative OSA outcome.
Primary analysis requires PSG-confirmed OSA and non-ambiguous technique denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Rescue-treatment cohorts for pre-existing OSA after flap.
Technique arms with ambiguous denominator excluded from the primary per-technique model.

registration.notes: Use as a transparency limitation; do not claim prospective registration until completed.

notes: Protocol frozen for SIICUSP package after corrected extraction on 2026-05-14.
